content: E sigwey, Yowbad inagamag yakamiy o yey; peinan bo idaweids ya̱kids silma̱nin liba̱lab. Kadiloka taninuways mtowen Yeisuw, peinan Yowbad nikayeb neim, mamagina tanuwagan lun, datapwa̱louls waseg.
Ma̱wan Moses kweiboug itoukum Yowbad inabunatum waseg, e, Yeisuw-vak ma̱wan, itoukum inawotet to Yowbad nisek.
Moses yakawanan kalamwey-nen, tage Yeisuw yakawanan singay avakaein, ma̱wana yakawanan tawtelein bunatum. Tage bunatum yakawanan kalamwey kakit, ma̱wan Moses yakawanan.
(Bunatum katanok katanok tawteleins nisesus, tage tawtelein youd babaw Yowbad.)
Yowbad nabunatum waseg, natouwat Moses kweiboug itoukum nawotet babaw waseg, mamagina takatimlakay, ilana, “Igaw Yowbad mo bikaleiwag ma̱wan, ma̱wan.”
Tage Kelis, inabunatum waseg, bo itoukum mamagina Natun. Ya̱kids inabunatum ya̱kids; magat bitakapwapouts silma̱nin youd siyas bwanabwein nilivnek.
E, kuninuways Kululuwan Bwanabwein ilivan mamagina:

content.text: Awoum bikeikay ninoumiy ma̱wana tasiyas kweiboug niyakwaneigs wanawoud, mo ipiyaves gunakaleiwag.
Peinan timmiyas iyakwaneigs, o ikines gunawotet tawtoun, bweilim sinawavas waseg.
Tage gamag tasiyas bo ivasiganigs, mo alana, ‘Tut babaw itapleileiys mav. Nag ikakins gunaked.’
Kapasal nuwag, mo akawtunes, alana, ‘Tasiyas nag kadilok beisiws gunakabyeiwas waseg, nag.’”

content: O sigwey, kuvna̱ses amisinap beibwein. Awoum beivag ninoumiy kalbaleb, waseg bukupiyaves Tamwamov towen Yowbad, mo bukukwalouws waseg.
E, tut nagein, bweina kuggeiguys simsimiyas wasigeis yam katanok katanok, mata ge sinap kalbaleb bikatidavimiy mo bikeikay ninoumiy.
Mounid bitamsamwas Kelis waseg. Magat bitavvaluts idanamis waseg, ma̱wana wanmugwana nitanmises. Kukin gog nag, bo bitadeivs.

content.text: “Nagein gog, avei-tut bukuliganes aygan, awoum bikeikay ninoumiy, ma̱wana tasiyas kweiboug nipiyaves Yowbad.”

content: Kuninuways tasiyas nivasiganis Yowbad, peinan ipiyaves aygan, mtasiyas Moses nitokes ilisawes Yidipt, mo inounas siney.
Bo ivasiganis Yowbad sinawavas bweilim, mtasiyas takalbalebs; mo ikanka̱nigs wanawoud.
E, Yowbad bo isek anilivan mounid mamagina:
Anilivan ma̱wan, peinan singaya ikapidabs waseg.
E, taninuways. Tasiyas nag kadilok beisiws sikabyeiwas waseg, peinan nag isimounids.
